penalties.authority: Income Tax Department, National Faceless Penalty Centre
penalties.details: The Company has received penalty order from the Income Tax Department under section 271(1)(c) of the Income-tax Act, 1961, imposing a penalty of Rs. 615,268/- for Assessment Year 2013-14.
penalties.impact: Based on the Company’s assessment, the Company believes that the penalty order is not sustainable and is taking necessary steps to appeal against the order before the appropriate Authority. The Company is hopeful of a favourable outcome at the appellate level. Accordingly, the Company believes that there will be no impact on its financials, operations or other activities due to this order.

industry: Information Technology > IT - Software > Software Products

operating_notes.text: Product licences and related activities contributed 90.6% of Q4FY26 revenue at ₹1,871 Cr, up 21% YoY.
The group recorded a ₹27 Cr provision for employee benefits under the new Labour Codes in Q4FY26 and ₹77 Cr for FY26.

Conditions precedent for the March 26 transaction — perpetual licence of software products plus transition services and personnel to an existing US-headquartered global bank customer — were fulfilled, with agreements being signed; no value
Revenue concentration: 51% of revenue comes from Oracle Corporation, through which OFSS sells to end users globally.
R&D spend was about 10% of total revenue in FY26.
Return on equity was 33% consolidated and 38% unconsolidated for FY26.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,065.2 Cr (+20.3% YoY), net profit ₹841.7 Cr (+30.7% YoY).

2026-05-27: OFSS said conditions precedent for its March 26 perpetual software licence and transition-services transaction with a US-headquartered global bank customer were fulfilled, with the License Agreement and other agreements being signed.

On 23 July 2026, OFSS held its 37th AGM where CEO Makarand Padalkar stepped down and CFO Vinay Ketkar was appointed MD & CEO effective 24 July 2026; FY26 revenue rose 12% to ₹7,670 Cr with net income up 11% to ₹2,640 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,906.6 Cr (+6.6% YoY), net profit ₹702.4 Cr (+28.6% YoY).
